figures.finding: The Norwegian Film Institute funds features two ways: by artistic assessment, and by market assessment at up to NOK 14.2 million (audience estimate over 250,000 tickets) or NOK 9.8 million (over 150,000), the latter capped at 50% of the approved budget with 80% of finance confirmed; the Institute's total for one film may not pass NOK 35 million, all public money 75% (market) or 80% (artistic) of costs, and a post-release grant pays 75% of the film's Norwegian revenues for three years once it sells 10,000 tickets.

value.cultureTest: at least 3 of 4 criteria (script originally in Norwegian or Sami; Norwegian theme; set in Norway/EEA; EEA-resident creators)

figures.applies: Norway; independent Norwegian (or EEA) production companies organised as AS; NFI feature production support pages read 2026-11-01.

sources.said: Høyt nivå innebærer tilskudd på inntil 14.200.000 kroner, og forutsetter et publikumsestimat på over 250.000 solgte billetter i ordinær kinodistribusjon. Lavt nivå innebærer tilskudd på inntil 9.800.000 kroner, og forutsetter et publikumsestimat på over 150.000 solgte billetter i ordinær kinodistribusjon. … Tilskuddet kan ikke overstige 50% av filmens godkjente budsjett.

Samlet tilskudd fra Norsk filminstitutt til utvikling, produksjon og etterhåndstilskudd kan maksimalt være 35 000 000 kroner. Det maksimale samlede offentlige tilskuddet skal ikke overstige 80% av de godkjente regnskapsførte utviklings-, og produksjonskostnadene.

figures.finding: Few feature applications to the Norwegian Film Institute succeed: in 2025 it granted 7 of 71 artistic-assessment feature applications and 6 of 61 market-assessment ones, and 73 production grants in all from 368 applications by Norwegian majority producers (NOK 253.5 million).
figures.applies: Norway, NFI decisions in 2025 (annual report 2025). The report's prose says '73 av 295 søknader'; its table gives 368 applications, 73 grants, 295 rejections.

figures.finding: Norway's incentive scheme, run by the Norwegian Film Institute, refunds up to 25% of approved costs incurred in Norway for features with a total budget of at least NOK 25 million (NOK 10 million for documentaries) and at least NOK 4 million spent in Norway, with at least 30% international finance and an international distribution deal; producer overheads and indirect producer fees are not approved costs. In 2025 it took 9 applications and granted 8, NOK 66.8 million.

value.producerRequirement: lead producer made at least one film or series publicly shown in the last five years

figures.applies: Norway; Norwegian and foreign production companies through a Norwegian AS set up for the production; applications before work starts.

sources.said: Du kan søke om å få refundert inntil 25 % av godkjente produksjonskostnader for produksjonen i Norge. … 25.000.000 kroner for spillefilm 10.000.000 kroner for dokumentarfilm … minimumsforbruk av godkjente kostnader i Norge på 4.000.000 kroner. Produksjonen må dokumentere en finansieringsplan som består av minimum 30 % internasjonal finansiering på søknadstidspunktet.
Kostnader som ikke godkjennes av Norsk filminstitutt … Indirekte produsentgodtgjørelser. Overheads/indirekte kostnader, herunder administrasjonsgodtgjørelse.
Insentivordningen mottok i 2025 totalt ni søknader. Åtte prosjekter delte den totale rammen på 66,8 millioner kroner.

figures.finding: 35 Norwegian films opened in cinemas in 2025 (40 in 2024), with 2.62 million admissions and a 31% market share; the six most-seen took 65% of all admissions to Norwegian films.
figures.applies: Norway, Norwegian cinema films 2023 to 2025 (NFI annual report 2025).

figures.finding: Norway's producers' association is Produsentforeningen in Virke, with nearly 170 independent production companies as members; it negotiates the collective agreements with the unions.
figures.applies: Norway; film, TV and game producers; page read 2026-11-01 (membership price behind a separate Virke page, not read).

sources.said: Produsentforeningen i Virke organiserer og jobber for norske film-, tv- og spillprodusenter. Virke har nærmere 170 uavhengige produksjonsselskaper som medlemmer.

figures.finding: Norway's incentive scheme refunds nothing on indirect producer fees or on overheads and indirect costs, administration fees included.
figures.applies: Norway, film and series productions applying to the NFI's incentive scheme, as published 2026-11-01; the cap on fees in NFI production support budgets is not given here.
